character_sheet: A hostile skeletal wraith with a scythe: a bare spine, pelvis and tailbone with no legs at all, a ribcage of forty rib and vertebra pieces, two bony arms hung from shoulder blocks, the right hand carrying a 39-long scythe with a bladed head, two wings of two spars and a zero-thickness sail each, and a boxy skull (ModelEnderReaper.java:161-423, 66 parts). 90 HP, 18 damage, 8 armour, speed 0.37 (EnderReaper.java:199-207). It is an enderman's heir: it hunts only the player who looks at it (the pumpkin-stare test :184-197 selects the target :87-141), screams while it holds that stare (DATA_SCREAMING :39-40, set at :116 and on a hit at :341), teleports away from a starer within 4 blocks (:273-277) and toward a far target it has held 30 ticks (:278-280), flees daylight (:245-254) and water or fire (:258-261), drowns in rain (:226-228) and sheds portal particles (:230-239); a melee goal bites at 18 (:54). It spawns in the dark at night above y 30 with no other reaper within 16 blocks (:366-374), through the dark forest, highlands and lowlands biome modifiers and in the Chaos and Island biomes. Read it as a floating skeleton: no stride, a hover, the wings and the scythe carrying the mood.
size_notes: Drawn at x1.0 of the rig (EnderReaperRenderer.java:25; shadow 0.2, :27) on a 512x512 sheet (ModelEnderReaper.java:425), enderreaper.png (EnderReaperRenderer.java:19); the hitbox is 0.7 x 2.9 (ModEntities.java:92-94). The original's ModelEnderReaper(0.23f) argument was the wingspeed, not a scale (ModelEnderReaper.java:19-20; EnderReaperRenderer.java:10-15).

groups.name: wings
groups.amplitude: calm: pi x 0.06 = 0.188 rad (11 deg) about the 0.785 rad rest at 0.7 x 0.23 = 0.161 rad/tick; screaming: pi x 0.3 = 0.942 rad (54 deg) about the same rest at 2.7 x 0.23 = 0.621 rad/tick; the three right parts the negative
groups.plain: the six wing parts sweep together about the vertical: a slow 11-degree stir when calm, a wide 54-degree beat while screaming
groups.math: w = screaming ? cos(t * 2.7 * 0.23) * pi * 0.3 : cos(t * 0.7 * 0.23) * pi * 0.06; lwing1.yRot = lwing2.yRot = lwing3.yRot = 0.785 + w; rwing1.yRot = rwing2.yRot = rwing3.yRot = -0.785 - w
groups.phase: the synched DATA_SCREAMING boolean (EnderReaper.java:39-40) selects the branch
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 0.7 x 0.23 calm (a 39-tick period) and x 2.7 x 0.23 screaming (a 10.1-tick beat)

groups.name: scythe
groups.amplitude: walking (calm): the shaft dips from its 1.0 rad rest by |cos(t x 1.3 x 0.23)| x pi x 0.25 x the walking speed above a limbSwingAmount of 0.1 (up to 0.785 rad, 45 deg, one-sided), still at 1.0 below; screaming: 1.0 + cos(t x 1.9 x 0.23) x pi x 0.25 (45 deg each way, unscaled) overrides the walk
groups.plain: the scythe rolls at the right hand: a one-sided dip with the stride when calm, a full swing either way while screaming
groups.math: a = amount > 0.1 ? cos(t * 1.3 * 0.23) * pi * 0.25 * amount : 0; scythe1.zRot = scythe2.zRot = scythe3.zRot = 1.0 - |a|; screaming: scythe1/2/3.zRot = 1.0 + cos(t * 1.9 * 0.23) * pi * 0.25
groups.phase: the limbSwingAmount threshold of 0.1 gates the dip; DATA_SCREAMING replaces it with the swing
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 1.3 x 0.23 = 0.299 walking (the absolute value halves the period to 10.5 ticks) and x 1.9 x 0.23 = 0.437 screaming (a 14.4-tick swing)

groups.amplitude: calm: xRot -2.436, yRot 1.0 (the forearm swung back and up); screaming: xRot -0.436, yRot -0.488 (snapped forward and inward) — a switch, not a wave

behaviour: Two branches on the synched DATA_SCREAMING boolean (EnderReaper.java:39-40; ModelEnderReaper.java:434-445). Calm, the left forearm is held back and up (xRot -2.436, yRot 1.0, :442-443) and the six wing parts stir 11 degrees about their 45-degree rest at 0.161 rad/tick, a 39-tick period (:444, :446-449). Screaming, the forearm snaps forward (-0.436 / -0.488, :438-439), the wings beat 54 degrees at 0.621 rad/tick, a 10-tick beat (:440), and the scythe swings 45 degrees each way about 1.0 rad at 0.437 rad/tick (:435-437).

The walk moves only the scythe: above a limbSwingAmount of 0.1 the shaft and both blade planes dip from 1.0 rad by |cos(t x 0.299)| x 0.785 x the walking speed (:431-433) — a one-sided dip at a 10.5-tick period, since the absolute value halves the cosine's period; still, the shaft rests at 1.0 rad. Screaming overrides the dip with the full swing (:436).

The skull yaws with the look at 0.45 of the head yaw, clamped to ±0.45 rad (:450-456); it never pitches. Everything else — the spine, pelvis, tailbone and neck, the forty rib and vertebra pieces, both shoulder blocks, the whole right arm and the left upper arm — is static (:169-391).

The rig has no legs: it stands on a tailbone (:177-179) and moves at 0.37 (EnderReaper.java:203), so its walk reads as a glide. The flag goes up on the first tick of a held stare (:116) and on any hit (:341); it drops when the nearest player looks away (:121), at the daylight escape (:251), when wet or burning (:259) and whenever the target is gone (:282) — a held state, not a pulse.

The teleports (:289-336) are instant moves with a sound pair at the origin and the landing (:314-315) and a portal trail — no pose today; the scream is the ambient sound while the flag is up (:351-353).

wishlist: in `idle`: a floating skeleton's hover — there are no legs (ModelEnderReaper.java:169-179: spine, pelvis, tailbone), so let the ribcage rise and fall and the wing sails (:161-167) drift; the code gives it only the 11-degree wing stir (:444)
in `walk`: a glide, not a stride — the code moves only the scythe with the walk (:431-433); a lean into the travel and the wings trailing sell the 0.37 speed
in `aggro_idle` (the screaming branch): keep the 54-degree wing beat (:440, :446-449) and the scythe's wide swing (:435-437), and make the left forearm's snap forward (:438-439) the tell
in `attack`: a real scythe swing with the right arm — rarm1 (:369-371) carries the shaft (:393-403) and the code never moves it; the MeleeAttackGoal lands 18 (EnderReaper.java:54, :204)
in `teleport`: a fold of the wings and a dissolve on the portal sound pair (EnderReaper.java:314-315)
formulas: `ModelEnderReaper.poseFrom` (ModelEnderReaper.java:437-465; orig ModelEnderReaper.java:489-513 in `render` (func_78088_a, :484-581; func_78087_a at :589-591 is a bare super call), wingspeed 0.23 from `new ModelEnderReaper(0.23f)` in orig ClientProxyOreSpawn.java:474 - the port's WINGSPEED): while the walking speed is above a tenth the swing is the cosine of the age in ticks times 1.3 times the wingspeed, times pi, times 0.25, times the walking speed, else 0; the three scythe pieces roll by 1.0 minus its absolute value. Screaming, the scythe pieces roll instead by 1.0 plus the cosine of the age times 1.9 times the wingspeed, times pi, times 0.25, the left arm pitches -0.436 and yaws -0.488, and the wing beat is the cosine of the age times 2.7 times the wingspeed, times pi, times 0.3; not screaming, the left arm pitches -2.436 and yaws 1.0 and the wing beat is the cosine of the age times 0.7 times the wingspeed, times pi, times 0.06. The three left wing pieces yaw by 0.785 plus the beat, the three right wing pieces by -0.785 minus it. The head yaws by the look yaw in radians times 0.45, clamped to plus or minus 0.45. The walk position and the look pitch play no part. The GeckoLib hook is the same (EnderReaperGeoReplacement.applyCustomAnimations).
